# DealCloud Pricing Overview

Last updated: July 28, 2026

## DealCloud Pricing FAQs

Generated using AI

### Is DealCloud free, or does it offer a free trial?

No. According to G2 data, DealCloud does not offer a free plan or free trial. Users need to purchase a paid plan to access the product. Visit the seller's official pricing page for current pricing details and plan options.

### Who is DealCloud pricing best suited for?

DealCloud's pricing is best suited for small to mid-market financial services firms, particularly in private equity, venture capital, and investment banking. The majority of G2 reviewers identifying their segment are small businesses in financial services or investment management, and they consistently highlight deal pipeline tracking, contact management, and Microsoft suite integration as core value drivers. Mid-market reviewers in VC and banking also report strong satisfaction with workflow customization and team-wide data centralization. DealCloud's custom-quote model and implementation complexity make it less accessible for budget-constrained teams or those without dedicated admins, but well-matched for firms treating CRM as core infrastructure.

### What are the key differences between the free and paid versions of DealCloud?

DealCloud offers no free tier. According to G2's pricing data for DealCloud, all access is governed by custom enterprise quotes with no publicly listed tiers. There is no free plan or standard self-serve entry point. Prospective buyers must engage DealCloud's sales team directly to obtain pricing. G2 reviewers note that DealCloud's pricing model reflects its positioning as a purpose-built financial services CRM rather than a general-purpose tool. This means evaluation typically occurs through vendor-led demos rather than self-service trials, and cost is negotiated based on firm size, use case, and required modules such as compliance integrations via Intapp.

### Is DealCloud considered good value for its pricing?

G2 reviewers present a mixed but generally positive value picture for DealCloud's pricing. Multiple reviewers from small businesses in PE, VC, and investment banking award high ratings while explicitly flagging high cost and a steep learning curve as drawbacks, signaling a premium-tier investment. One reviewer rated DealCloud 2.0/5 citing high price alongside limited customization. Others rated it 4.5–5.0/5 despite cost concerns, pointing to deal pipeline automation, Microsoft suite integration, and deep customizability as justifying the spend. DealCloud's pricing appears defensible for firms that fully utilize its purpose-built financial services functionality, but cost-sensitive or smaller organizations may find the value proposition harder to realize.

Lars d.

Small-Business (50 or fewer emp.)

"Flexible Database Management, Needs UI Improvement"

What do you like best about DealCloud?

I really like DealCloud's flexibility. It's great that we can create new data objects and add or remove fields, which is super important for us as a growing organization. We're constantly getting new insights every month, and with the advancements in AI, it's crucial that we can easily add or delete objects and fields to keep our system up-to-date and running effectively. Review collected by and hosted on G2.com.

What do you dislike about DealCloud?

I think the usability from the user interface side is sometimes a bit intuitive and clunky. For example, the tasks are not really that usable. Also, it would be way better if DealCloud itself would provide an MCP to connect to programs like cloud or Copilot. Now I need to build that myself, which is fine, but it just makes the usability of DealCloud less relevant. Review collected by and hosted on G2.com.

Response from David Byrne of DealCloud

Thank you for the great review, Lars! We’re so glad you’re finding value in DealCloud. It seems that you have already been in contact with some of our team members regarding the MCP connection and integrations. We are excited about how this new functionality will help firms just like yours. Thanks for sharing your experience as it helps others see how DealCloud can make an impact.

"Effective Deal Tracking with Room for Improvement"

What do you like best about DealCloud?

I like how DealCloud tracks deals and emails, making it easy to see correspondence and bid dates. Review collected by and hosted on G2.com.

What do you dislike about DealCloud?

I find the manual data entry for deals or person information a bit tedious. Also, the initial setup was hard for my team. Review collected by and hosted on G2.com.

Response from David Byrne of DealCloud

Roman, we truly appreciate the feedback on your DealCloud experience. We continue to look at how we can simplify certain processes or make things a little easier. If you have specific thoughts on enhancements you might like to see, please share them with your Account Manager.

We love hearing how DealCloud helps clients more efficiently track communications and key pipeline information like bid dates.

![Daniel K.](https://g2.com/assets/transparent-ad5be28fbcd25b7b08d2cebe1d957125437fb5407d75ee717965ad22c8808791.gif)
DK

Daniel K.

Growth Equity Analyst

Small-Business (50 or fewer emp.)

"Robust Features But Needs UI Improvements"

What do you like best about DealCloud?

I really appreciate the reporting flexibility that DealCloud offers, especially when you're well-versed in a list-based software structure. This feature allows me to customize and extract data efficiently, adapting reports to meet specific requirements with ease. I also value the ability to configure almost anything within the platform, which empowers me to tailor the system extensively so it aligns perfectly with our business processes and workflows. The centralization of all firm-wide knowledge is another aspect that stands out for me, as it consolidates information in one cohesive hub, facilitating easy access and collaboration across different teams. This integration boosts our efficiency and supports decision-making by providing a comprehensive view of our organizational data. Additionally, I have successfully built modules myself to track deal team travel, manage deal flow and history, and automate tasks and fundraising activities, showcasing the platform’s versatility. Review collected by and hosted on G2.com.

What do you dislike about DealCloud?

I find the UI/UX of DealCloud to be sometimes slow, which can be quite frustrating. Additionally, the mobile app is extremely bad and borderline nonfunctional, making it difficult to use when I'm not at my desk. The initial setup of DealCloud was not easy but no CRM is. Review collected by and hosted on G2.com.

Response from David Byrne of DealCloud

Daniel, we’re so glad you’re finding value in DealCloud. DealCloud is highly configurable and its great to hear that you have created customizations that align with your business needs and resulted in efficiencies for your team.

We appreciate the feedback on your UI/UX experience and the mobile app. Our team is always working on improvements, and your input helps us prioritize what matters most. Thanks for sharing your experience.

LA

Liibaan A.

"Purpose-Built CRM for Investment Banks, But Integration Hurdles"

What do you like best about DealCloud?

I appreciate DealCloud for automating low-value tasks, which is incredibly beneficial as it allows us to use the suggest contacts and Outlook add-in to ensure data entry is automatically populated into the system. This feature minimizes the need for data creation from the end user, which streamlines processes significantly and enhances efficiency. Additionally, I find the ability to customize widgets immensely valuable, as it allows users to view business processes through their preferred lens while keeping the data centralized within the system. This flexibility enables personalized user experiences while maintaining data integrity. DealCloud's purpose-built functionality for investment banks is particularly appealing, as it distinguishes itself from more generic CRM solutions like Salesforce. The initial setup was smooth, and I value the ease of transitioning to a system that aligns so well with our specific industry needs. Review collected by and hosted on G2.com.

What do you dislike about DealCloud?

I find the integrations with other platforms challenging, particularly those requiring a bespoke API integration. Although the DealCloud API documentation is very helpful, the process of getting these integrations up and running is often difficult. Review collected by and hosted on G2.com.

Response from David Byrne of DealCloud

Liibaan, we appreciate your review and are happy to hear that DealCloud has helped in streamlining processes for your team. It is great to hear how the ability to customize DealCloud is helping your team leverage the tool in a way that works best for the needs of your business and team.

Your feedback on the integrations is also appreciated. Sometimes they can be tricky. Please don't hesitate to reach out to our Account Management and Client Success team whenever you need help. We're always here for you.
